Requirements summary (customer language / shorthand):

- Cost sensitivity: mid-high — willing to pay for predictability; procurement wants ARR estimate and unit cost per query with caching profiles.

- Caching: prefix/KV cache expected to reduce cost for repeated query patterns (law firm templates). Want cost model to show savings across 6/12 months.
